trust_decision.summary: The Studio server trusts any HTTP caller (any interface, any web origin, no auth) and passes request-body agent/prompt into child processes spawned through a shell; the decision lives in the global CORS middleware, the listen() bind, and per-spawn shell/agent-name checks in cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js.

landing_point.why: Summary names the --studio server and command injection; POST /api/execute is the main body-driven endpoint and leads to the claude spawn with shell:true at cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js:464-473.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP route of `cct --studio` (global CORS middleware; fix.diff:74-90 adds origin allowlist + 403)
POST /api/install-agent (agentName; fix.diff:108-130 adds allowlist, removes shell:true)
POST /api/execute (mode local or cloud, non-default agent) via checkAndInstallAgent (fix.diff:137-150)
server start for `cct --studio` (cli-tool/src/index.js:130-131, cli-tool/src/index.js:2643-2646; fix.diff:184 binds 127.0.0.1)
module scope; fix.diff:59-60 adds NPX_CMD/CLAUDE_CMD win32 shims so shell removal keeps Windows working

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published fix sites are in cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js; no site in another module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The cloud route's shell sink runs inside a disposable remote E2B sandbox (cli-tool/components/sandbox/e2b/e2b-launcher.py:151-152, advertised as 'SECURE CLOUD SANDBOX' at cli-tool/components/sandbox/e2b/e2b-launcher.py:249), and the agent already exists locally, so 'nothing is installed and nothing runs on the host'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The same-origin Studio UI must keep posting to /api/execute (it sends Origin http://localhost:3444), Origin-less clients must keep working, agent names are category/name slugs with '/', '.', '-', and free-form prompts containing quotes, $, ; must reach claude intact as one argv; a fix that blocks all Origins, rejects metacharacters in prompts, or forbids '/' in agent names breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: agent in POST /api/execute body, local mode, reaching checkAndInstallAgent (fix.diff:138)
agent in POST /api/execute body, cloud mode, reaching the same helper (cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js:323-325)
prompt embedded in finalPrompt for the local claude spawn (fix.diff:165)
request Origin header: absent, allowed localhost/127.0.0.1 origin, foreign origin (fix.diff:80-90)

O7_producer.where: Agent and prompt come straight from express.json body at cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js:114 and are stored in the in-memory task at cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js:126-137; no schema/serializer/cache.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/execute with a non-default agent whose lexically-normalised path hits an existing .md file: checkAndInstallAgent returns true before the published allowlist, so the unvalidated agent flows on to the cloud launcher argv and then into a shell command string in the E2B sandbox.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Agent 'already installed' means no install spawn runs, the local spawn is now shell-free, and the only remaining shell is in a remote cloud sandbox in another language and directory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file for the early return; sink in cli-tool/components/sandbox/e2b/e2b-launcher.py:151-152 (other directory, Python), reached via cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js:336-343

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/execute mode=cloud: agent is interpolated into a single '--agent=... --yes' argv and the launcher runs it through the sandbox shell; the published fix never touched this composition and depends on the helper's regex being reached first.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: spawn('python3', ...) has no shell:true, so it looks safe from the Node side; the shell is in the Python launcher's sbx.commands.run.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted POST /api/task/:taskId/retry or /api/uninstall-agent that re-spawns npx with an agent taken from req.params/body
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Task routes already exist keyed by id, and install-agent shows the maintainer's pattern of spawning npx with a body field.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: pass cloud mode extra components (command/mcp/setting) from the body into the same '--x=value' argv string the launcher shells out
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CLI's own sandbox path already builds a componentsToInstall string for launchers (cli-tool/src/index.js:3210), so extending Studio cloud mode to it is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cached 'installed agents' check (e.g. reading .claude/agents listing) whose result skips validation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The existsSync short-circuit already precedes validation; a cache/listing is a plausible optimisation.

O9_family: OS command injection via unauthenticated, CSRF-reachable local dev server (CWE-78/306/352)

O10_build.language: JavaScript (Node.js; Python launcher for cloud mode)
O10_build.project_tests: jest suites under cli-tool/tests (cli-tool/package.json:21-27); none reference sandbox-server.js (only cli-tool/src/index.js mentions it). Note sandbox-server.js calls app.listen at require time (cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js:562) and exports app (cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js:579).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop shell:true on the claude spawn in executeLocalTask (the reproduced path) and stop, leaving CORS/bind, install-agent and the cloud agent route untouched.
